verdict.rationale: Airbyte's public API is URL-versioned at /v1, and Airbyte documents a commitment to publish migration guides for breaking API changes, with dated per-change deprecation notices such as the standalone API server deprecation. However, its own docs state there is no formal version-lifecycle or sunset-policy document, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half is only approximated by ad-hoc announcements. Missing for 10: a formal deprecation/sunset policy with defined timelines, a version-lifecycle document covering multiple API versions, independent corroboration of deprecation handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Airbyte publishes migration guides to assist with any breaking changes to our API users.
We're deprecating the standalone Airbyte API server and moving the routes into the Airbyte server
